ULTRA PRO SPACE INVADERS — PREMIUM EDUCATIONAL EDITION
=======================================================

Thank you for your purchase!

This product is delivered ONLINE — there is no software to install.

  1. Open Buyer_Welcome_Guide.pdf (in this folder) for full
     instructions, troubleshooting, and license terms.

  2. Go to:   https://purebrainplay.com
     Enter your access code (sent in your purchase email and
     printed on the Welcome Guide).

  3. To play with YOUR OWN questions, edit the included file
     "50 money banking questions for space invaders.txt"
     using the same format, then load it from the game's
     Settings panel (Settings -> Load My Questions).

ACCESS CODES ROTATE EVERY FEW MONTHS — you will receive each
new code automatically by email at no extra cost for the lifetime
of your purchase.

Need help?  Use the "Ask a Question" tab on the TpT product page.
